title: Who is Cantarella? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 2310 'Profile Reveal | Sea of Dreams — Cantarella': the current head of Fisalia, Cantarella, the Bane; resides in a crown-like castle atop the mountain where illusory dreams flow like streams. Quote: 'Whether I am the Bane of the wicked or the pure is yours to decide.' Attribute Havoc, Weapon Rectifier, 5 stars

Official news 2311 'Post-Lament Anthropocene: Stars Intertwined | Cantarella' lore images: Laying the Groundwork (Porto-Veno Castle perched on cliffs; poisonous flowers thrive; unwelcome visitors always end up lost in the garden); Unconventional Desserts (octopus scones with an eerie blue glow, Jellyrose juice; the toxins secreted from the tip of her tongue neutralize the toxins, but only if consumed in a specific order: 'Eat them in the correct order, or... bad things could happen.'); A Brand on the Tongue (she has tasted poisonous Jellyrose Medusa and blue-ringed octopus; a Tacet Mark runs from the tip of her tongue down to her throat); Resonance Evaluation Report (a rare form of hallucinogenic toxin; when swarms of jellyfish emerge from her parasol, an exquisite sea of illusions forms around her); Coral Parasol (violence has never been her first choice); Thoughts ('Can I mix you a jug of Violaca juice? It soothes nerves and eases fatigue.')
Art: official Kuro Games images, cropped only (see presskit/SOURCE.txt), credited on screen

scenes.narration: Whether she's the Bane of the wicked or of the pure is yours to decide. This is Cantarella, head of the Fisalia family, in Wuthering Waves.
She lives in Porto-Veno Castle, high on the cliffs. Poisonous flowers thrive there, and unwelcome visitors always get lost in the garden.
Her desserts? Glowing octopus scones and Jellyrose juice. Her own toxins neutralize them, but only if you eat them in the right order.
She's tasted poisonous Medusa and blue-ringed octopus. Now a Tacet Mark runs from the tip of her tongue, down to her throat.
Her poison is a rare hallucinogen. Jellyfish swarm from her parasol, and her enemies drift into a sea of illusions.
She's a five-star Havoc Resonator. And if you look tired, she'll gladly mix you a jug of Violaca juice.
So, would you drink Cantarella's juice? Tell me in the comments.
